prompts: Create a production 2D game sprite sheet with TRUE TRANSPARENT background, 2 columns x 2 rows, FOUR equal square cells, NO text or grid. Use the attached reference as exact character and artistic design: cheerful dwarf with red cap, white beard, blue eyes, teal blue coat, yellow shirt, brown trousers and boots, glowing golden lantern. SAME dwarf repeated four times, whole body visible in each equal cell. Four coherent walking cycle frames, facing three-quarter right: top-left left foot forward/right back; top-right passing pose; bottom-left right foot forward/left back; bottom-right opposite passing pose. Lantern carried low in left hand, right arm relaxed, no pointing. Small unmistakable alternate leg movement, arms gently counter-swing. Keep identical character height, head size, body proportions, lighting and foot baseline in ALL FOUR cells. Soft volumetric hand painted storybook rendering like the reference. Each character centered in its own cell, ample padding all around, no overlapping cells, no background, no ground, no cast floor shadows. Transparent pixels must surround every sprite. Designed to animate without jumping in size.

Create a production 2D game sprite sheet with TRUE TRANSPARENT background, TWO equal square cells side by side, no text, no grid. Use attached reference ONLY for its soft volumetric storybook style and friendly dwarf proportions. Two DIFFERENT supporting mine dwarves, full body standing calm, uniformly sized and centered in each cell, feet at same baseline. LEFT: green cap, olive teal coat, copper belt buckle, small pickaxe resting at side, white beard, friendly expressive face. RIGHT: indigo blue cap, warm rust coat, small tool satchel, short pale beard, friendly face. Both off-duty support characters, arms resting, no dramatic gestures, no lantern, no pointing. Rich painted materials and warm highlights matching our main red-cap dwarf and woodland mine. Whole bodies and boots inside cells with ample padding. No background, no ground shadows, no extra characters. TRUE alpha transparent around each.
